what: Malformed realtime channel params become an internal-server error.
expected: Lazy stream emits public BAD_REQUEST for invalid params; internal data failures stay private.
root_cause: channelContext threw a native TypeError for client schema rejection. The Effect/native stream boundary retained it, and oRPC redacted it as an internal error.
fixed_by: Throw an explicit ORPCError BAD_REQUEST at the client parameter validation boundary; retain stored-value validation behavior. Same real API reproduction and regression tests now pass.

invariants: Lazy stream emits public BAD_REQUEST for invalid params; internal data failures stay private.
Foreign origins remain rejected; successful tools and event streams retain their contracts.
